{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the actual sites present
print("Unique sites in data:", df['site'].unique())

# Check if there are exactly 4 sites
print("Number of unique sites:", df['site'].nunique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of duplicate patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check sample_seq distribution
print("Max sample_seq per patient:", df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts())"}
